answer: One controller can still spawn many wallets and collect seats without local work. A claimant withdraws bronze relic disk TR-24 from the customs cage on jetty 3, carries it along the 180 m boardwalk, and flashes a 12-second semaphore signal encoding the disk's 6-digit serial. The disk bond is 24 coins, one serial per address, held 11 hours. Peers match the serial with the registrar, time the crossing within 9 minutes, and decode the semaphore against the posted day key. A reused serial, overtime crossing, dropped disk, or wrong bit voids the seat and burns the 24 coins.
